claim: At revision 52b0f00ebf28a0b4173921725ff170685ec2c502, the README example at line 168, Scene.FromFile("input.fbx", FileFormat.FBX7400Binary), fails to compile with CS1503 because the only FromFile overloads that take a FileFormat also require a CancellationToken.
suggested_issue_title: README "Enumerate a Scene's Node Hierarchy" calls Scene.FromFile(string, FileFormat), which has no such overload (CS1503)
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-03) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-.NET`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `52b0f00ebf28a0b4173921725ff170685ec2c502` on 2026-10-09T21:15Z.

## Summary

`Scene.cs` declares four static `FromFile` overloads: `(string, FileFormat, CancellationToken)`, `(string, LoadOptions, CancellationToken)`, `(string)` and `(string, CancellationToken)`. There is no `(string, FileFormat)` overload, so the README call has no match.

## Environment

- Revision `52b0f00ebf28a0b4173921725ff170685ec2c502` (default branch `main`)
- .NET SDK 10.0.401, console project on net10.0 with a `ProjectReference` to `src/main/Aspose.ThreeD/Aspose.ThreeD.csproj` (the library itself builds with 0 errors)

## Steps to reproduce

README.md lines 166-172 as `Program.cs`:

```csharp
using Aspose.ThreeD;
var scene = Scene.FromFile("input.fbx", FileFormat.FBX7400Binary);
foreach (var node in scene.RootNode.ChildNodes) { System.Console.WriteLine(node.Name); }
```

then `dotnet build`.

## Actual result

```
Program.cs(3,41): error CS1503: Argument 2: cannot convert from 'Aspose.ThreeD.FileFormat' to 'System.Threading.CancellationToken'
```

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:168` (README.md:85 and :299 also describe `FileFormat` constants used with `FromFile`)
- `src/main/Aspose.ThreeD/Aspose/ThreeD/Scene.cs:314, 324, 334, 344` (the four `FromFile` overloads); instance `Open(string, FileFormat, CancellationToken)` at `:217` and `Save(string, FileFormat)` at `:425`
